scope: Local AuthNotifier authority transitions and current full core_auth verification. Root composition, route guards and broader native coverage are owned by the root/coverage task.

files.why: Capture repository/session authority across every asynchronous path; invalidate pending state/observer work on repository rebuild, disposal, newer session and logout; close local logout immediately; validate numeric club/user identity before hydration and admin access; merge concurrent profile/admin results without restoring old snapshots; await trusted SDK hydration for matching sign-in completion.

Execute delayed success/error, repository replacement, disposal, old-subscription, account/club, OTP event ordering, second-await admin, concurrent profile/admin and logout races through real ProviderContainer/AuthNotifier instances using controlled fake repository responses.

authorityRules.capturedRepository: Every async repository invocation uses the repository captured with its authority scope, including restore failure cleanup. No await resumes through a replacement _repository field.
authorityRules.rebuildAndDisposal: Generation/lifetime counters invalidate old continuations; old subscriptions are canceled and their callbacks cannot bind to a rebuilt notifier. Pending SDK completion waiters are released on invalidation.
authorityRules.sessionChange: A new session removes the preceding user/profile/admin authority immediately, validates the returned profile user ID and numeric repository/profile club, and owns its separate hydration.
authorityRules.logout: Local unauthenticated state and diagnostic consent closure occur before awaiting repository cleanup; the cleanup reply has no post-await state or identity write.
authorityRules.staleActions: Existing AuthActionFailureKind.conflict and a finite session-changed message are returned; stale exceptions do not rewrite current state, resolve extra admin access or emit stale identity observations.
authorityRules.matchingSdkEvents: OTP/phone-verification responses may await their matching newer trusted event. Success requires its authenticated state; null/foreign/error hydration cannot report success. Deletion completion recognizes only its own earlier intentional signed-out event without rewriting state.
authorityRules.numericClubScope: Configured and returned numeric IDs must normalize to the same positive ID in 1..2147483647. Foreign/invalid profiles are not exposed or passed to admin resolution.
authorityRules.profileAndAdminConcurrency: Profile and admin requests carry separate latest-started revisions and merge the current valid counterpart, preventing old profile/access snapshots from replacing newer changes.
authorityRules.localGuest: Local offline guest fallback remains available and never resolves a server admin principal.
authorityRules.nativeAuthority: No native credential/journal module, capability or remote revocation/retry protocol was changed.

checks: Private profile omitted from state on rejection
No admin query for a foreign profile
No admin workspace privilege from foreign profile

failures: Delayed restore failure signed out replacement repository
Delayed admin response restored preceding user and privileges
Logout retained local authenticated authority while repository reply was pending

limits: The notifier fences local state, follow-up repository calls and observation calls. It does not roll back or cancel a backend action that was already dispatched.

All authority races use controlled fake repository responses and real Riverpod provider lifecycles; the full bank also executes existing core_auth contracts. No real provider, deployment or device acceptance is implied.
Flutter3.44.9 ran with --no-pub and analytics suppression. No OS network capture was performed.
